tut.win11_desc: Open Campaign and Stage {stage}. Tap all three hero portraits; a highlighted portrait means that hero is selected. Start only after all three are highlighted, then clear the stage.
tut.quest11_desc: Open Quests and claim the completed Stage {stage} objective. The starter quest chain awards {hero} fragments toward your fourth hero.

tut.gemwish_desc: Open the Wishing Pool and claim the free Diamond wish you earned. Your first Diamond wish guarantees a {stars} hero and gives you your fifth hero.

setx.tos_intro: Last updated: {date}. {game} (the “Game”) is provided by {company} (“we”, “us”). By accepting, you agree to our {terms}, and our {privacy} explains how we handle your information. This page is a summary; the full text is at those two links.
setx.tos_p1: You must be at least {min} (or older where your local law says so) to create an account. If you are under {adult}, or under the age of majority where you live, you need a parent or guardian's permission and supervision; they must agree to these Terms with you and authorize any purchases.
setx.tos_p2: Keep your password private and do not share, sell or transfer accounts. Do not cheat, exploit bugs, use bots or unauthorized tools, or interfere with the Game or other players. We may restrict or suspend accounts that break the rules, and correct progress gained by cheating.
setx.tos_p3: No harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual content involving minors, spam, impersonation or other illegal or abusive content. Report a message from chat, block players (your Blocked players list is in Settings), or email {mail}. Do not put passwords, payment details or sensitive personal information in chat.
setx.tos_p4: Purchases in the Google Play version use Google Play Billing; the purchase screen shows the price and what you get before you confirm, and Google processes the payment. Diamonds, gold, heroes and other items are licensed for use in the Game, have no cash value and cannot be sold outside the Game. Refunds follow the law and the store's policy (Google Play's refund process); your statutory consumer rights still apply.
setx.tos_p5: Your account details (username, a salted password hash, a recovery email if you add one), your game saves and activity, chat messages and reports you send, purchase records, and technical data: IP addresses, connection times, device and app information, and error and security logs. We use it to run the Game, keep accounts secure and play fair, moderate chat, deliver purchases and fix problems. We do not sell your personal information. Other players see your name, castle, game activity and the chat you send them.
setx.tos_p6: Your account and saves are stored on our game servers and copied to backups for recovery. Routine technical, connection, IP and diagnostic logs are kept for {days}. Backups age out on their own rotation schedule.
setx.tos_p7: Use {del} in Settings, or the request form at {form}, or email {mail}. The account is locked and hidden for a {grace}; signing in within those {n} days cancels the deletion. After that our servers wipe it from our database. Backups are not erased at once - they age out on their own schedule. A guest profile with no password is deleted at once.
setx.tos_p8: The Game changes through updates and balancing and is provided “as is” to the extent the law allows. These Terms are governed by the laws of {law}; mandatory consumer rights where you live are not affected. We update the date above when the Terms change and ask you to accept again.
setx.tos_p9: Questions, reports, privacy and deletion requests: {mail}.
setx.tos_review: Please review and accept to continue signing in.
